conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is 14.19% with 4 of the last 7 prints down by 8.6% to 19.8%; I take a moderate negative because the filing record shows a board reconstituted at the 2026-06-26 annual meeting after the founder's contested-proxy campaign, a new externally hired CEO whose appointment the market treated as a vote of no confidence, and a standalone item-8.01 8-K three weeks before the print that nothing in a 22-item news sweep mentions - the classic configuration for a guidance reset, into a stock that has just rallied 5.9% in five sessions.

findings.finding: An 8-K carrying ONLY item 8.01 (Other Events) was filed on 2026-08-13, three weeks before the print, and it is referenced nowhere in the 22-item pre-print news sweep, nowhere in the 150-item first sweep, and nowhere in the social stream - a standalone Other Events filing at a company three weeks from results is either a strategic announcement, a settlement or a disclosure the company wanted separated from the earnings release.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json, 8-K dated 2026-08-13 with items '8.01' - the most recent filing of any kind before the print
findings.why_not_priced: Item 8.01 has no standard interpretation, which is exactly why aggregators skip it, and this capture ran a 22-query news sweep on the morning of the print without surfacing a single August company announcement. The sign is genuinely uncertain - I lean negative because it sits between two 13D/A amendments (2026-07-20 and 2026-08-03) at a company whose board has just been changed - but the informative fact is that a material standalone disclosure exists and no observed coverage discusses it.
findings.independence: Two SCHEDULE 13D/A amendments bracket it (2026-07-20 and 2026-08-03), a separate filing series showing a >5% holder actively repositioning in the same weeks - https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001397187&type=SC+13D

findings.finding: The founder's proxy campaign appears to have changed the board: a PREC14A nominated Laura Gentile, Eric Hirshberg and Marc Maurer as Class I directors on a GOLD universal proxy card, the 2026 annual meeting produced an 8-K carrying items 5.02 AND 5.07 on 2026-06-26, and three days later on 2026-06-29 two Form 3s and eleven Form 4s were filed at once - i.e. new insiders seated on the board immediately after the vote.
findings.corpus_ref: docs/a6714b8a9efb77fcb23338c7664926c08439b598.txt (snapshots/20260903T151408Z.json item 19); filings.json 8-K dated 2026-06-26 items '5.02,5.07', two Form 3s and eleven Form 4s dated 2026-06-29, DEFA14A dated 2026-06-05
findings.why_not_priced: The proxy fight was covered; the outcome, read off the filing pattern, was not - no item in the news sweep reports who won, and the only mention of Chip Wilson is inside an undated SWOT piece. A reconstituted board and a new chief executive arriving together is the standard precondition for a guidance reset and a write-down quarter, and that is the mechanism the price has not discounted while it rallied 5.9% into the event.
findings.independence: The corpus separately records the leadership half of the same reset from independent sources - Calvin McDonald announcing his departure on the December 2025 third-quarter call and Heidi O'Neill's appointment being sold off as a 'vote of no confidence': https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/261815035-lululemon-lulu-stock-heidioeill-ceo-succession-nike-china-growth-tradingkey

findings.finding: The fundamentals going into the reset are already deteriorating on the company's own numbers: the corpus captures 'Lululemon cuts 2026 forecast as sales slump across Americas', a separate analysis titled 'Lululemon Q1 FY2026: The Brand Is Still There. The Business Has Fractured.', and a China-specific piece noting the China engine 'just hit a wall' with the stock down 46% in 2026.
findings.corpus_ref: snapshots/20260903T151408Z.json items 5, 7, 9 and 22 (headlines and stored bodies)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced - a 43.6% drawdown from the high says so, and this is the weakest of my three findings for exactly that reason. It matters only as the reason a new CEO would take a kitchen-sink quarter rather than defend the existing guide.
findings.independence: none - this is the consensus narrative and overlaps with everything else in the sweep.
